item.title: A homegrown Georgia moderate and pragmatist: Is Senator Ossoff the future of the Democratic Party?
item.description: Is Senator Jon Ossoff the future of the Democratic Party? Following a resounding midterm victory in Georgia, a former Republican stronghold, the 39-year-old senator has emerged as a prominent figure as the Democrats look ahead to 2028 for their next presidential nominee. His natural confidence, polished media performances and ability to appeal to a diverse electorate have prompted comparisons with Barack Obama. Yet behind the excitement surrounding his national prospects lies a more complicated question: whether political momentum in the Senate necessarily translates into a presidential… Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: A diez mil metros de altura, León XIV se ha mostrado pletórico por su primer viaje a América Latina. item.title: Trump replaces Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller as chief of staff after GOP’s midterm defeat
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that Stephen Miller would replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff, elevating a long-time loyalist and architect of his immigration crackdown days after Republicans lost control of Congress. Miller, currently a deputy chief of staff, will take over on Monday. Wiles will move to Trump’s political operation, the president said in a post on social media. The change puts one of Trump’s staunchest ideological allies in charge of the White House staff... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post, Al Jazeera English.
